# The 33rd Executive Suites

> A boutique luxury hotel in Babesa, Thimphu — one of Bhutan’s only 100% vegetarian and vegan-friendly hotels, with a rooftop bar, Om Spa, signature dining and valley-view suites.

The 33rd Executive Suites is a boutique luxury hotel on Babesa Highway, Thimphu 11001, Bhutan. Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 12:00 PM. Rates are not published online: guests send a booking request and the reservations team replies with availability and the best available rate.

## Contact
- Phone & WhatsApp: +975 16993333
- Email: reservation@the33rdes.com
- Address: Babesa Highway, Thimphu 11001, Bhutan
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/rQMKaKK3ZH1KMMmD8
- Book: https://the33rdes.com/book/

## Rooms & Suites
- [Valley Suite](https://the33rdes.com/rooms/valley-suite/): 30 m², King or Twin bed, up to 2 guests, Valley & Monastery view, bathtub, mini kitchen.
- [Executive Suite](https://the33rdes.com/rooms/executive-suite/): 30 m², King or Twin bed, up to 2 guests, City view, bathtub, mini kitchen.
- [Deluxe Suite](https://the33rdes.com/rooms/deluxe-suite/): 30 m², King or Twin bed, up to 2 guests, City view, mini kitchen.
- [Deluxe Premium](https://the33rdes.com/rooms/deluxe-premium/): 30 m², King or Twin bed, up to 2 guests, City view.
- [Deluxe Standard](https://the33rdes.com/rooms/deluxe-standard/): 30 m², King or Twin bed, up to 2 guests, City view.

Every room has: Rain shower, Air conditioning, Smart TV with satellite channels, High-speed in-room Wi-Fi, Minibar & fridge, Tea & coffee making facilities, Bathrobes & slippers, Premium toiletries & hairdryer, In-room safe, Study desk & telephone, Complimentary refilled water, 24-hour room service, Laundry service, Wake-up call service.
Every room can be booked with breakfast (daily vegetarian breakfast buffet included) or without breakfast (room only).

## Guest guidelines
### Early arrival / late departure
- Early arrival: check-in is at 2:00 PM. Early arrivals can store luggage and use our facilities until the room is ready. Early check-in is subject to availability and may incur an extra fee.
- Late departure: check-out is at 12:00 PM. Late check-out requests are subject to availability and additional charges. For a guaranteed late check-out, please contact reception in advance.

### Cancellation policy
- Cancellations made less than 45 days before the scheduled arrival date will be subject to a 50% cancellation fee.
- Cancellations made 30 days or less before the scheduled arrival date, as well as no-shows, will be charged the full amount of the reservation.
- Group bookings (more than 5 rooms) have different cancellation policies; please contact reservations for the details.

## Frequently asked questions
### Where is The 33rd Executive Suites?
We are on Babesa Highway, Thimphu 11001, Bhutan, in Babesa on the southern side of Thimphu, Bhutan’s capital — on the road in from Paro International Airport.

### Is breakfast included?
Every room can be booked with or without breakfast. With breakfast, guests enjoy the daily vegetarian breakfast buffet at Artisan’s Table; without breakfast, the rate is for the room only. You choose when you send your booking request.

### What is the cancellation policy?
Cancellations made less than 45 days before the scheduled arrival date are subject to a 50% cancellation fee. Cancellations made 30 days or less before arrival, and no-shows, are charged the full amount of the reservation. Group bookings of more than 5 rooms have different cancellation policies — please contact reservations for the details.

### What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 12:00 PM. Late check-out can be requested when you book, subject to availability.

### Is the hotel vegetarian?
Yes. The 33rd Executive Suites is one of Bhutan’s only 100% vegetarian and vegan-friendly hotels. Breakfast, the Artisan’s Table restaurant, Private Dining, Salts Rooftop Bar and Sugar Box Café all serve vegetarian food.

### Do you offer airport transfers from Paro?
Yes. A private chauffeured transfer between Paro International Airport and the hotel can be added when you book.

### What is included in every room?
Rooms have a rain shower, high-speed Wi-Fi, a smart TV, a minibar, tea and coffee facilities and 24-hour room service, and most have a mini kitchen and microwave. The Valley and Executive Suites also have a bathtub. Every room can be booked with or without our daily vegetarian breakfast, and fitness centre access is included in your stay.

### How do I book and see the rates?
Choose your dates and room on our website and send a booking request — our reservations team replies with availability and the best available rate. You can also call or WhatsApp +975 16993333 or email reservation@the33rdes.com.

### Does the hotel have a spa and a rooftop bar?
Yes. Om Spa offers massages with steam and sauna, and Salts Rooftop Bar on the seventh floor is open daily from 10:00 AM to midnight with views over the valley.
